request_text: Load case14 and run the power flow, then report the bus with the lowest voltage magnitude.
answer:
Buses are identified by the bus name column 1 through 14. Slack bus is bus 1 at 1.06 p.u. and 0 degrees. PV generator buses are 2, 3, 6, and 8 with specified voltage magnitudes. Load buses are 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, and 14, while buses 2, 3, and 6 also have local load plus generation. Branches include all 15 lines with line_id equal to the net.line row index 0 through 14, and 5 transformers with line_id equal to 100000 plus transformer row index, namely 100000 through 100004.

Requested quantities are bus voltage magnitude in p.u. and angle in degrees, and branch sending-end active power in MW. Loading percent is requested, but branch thermal ratings are undefined, so it is reported as 0 for every branch. Totals requested are total generation MW, total load MW, and total real losses MW. Voltage overrun check means any bus below 0.95 p.u. or above 1.05 p.u.; line overrun check means any branch loading above 100 percent, which will be false here because loading is defined as 0.

This is the standard IEEE 14-bus AC power flow with the given bus loads, PV voltage setpoints, and branch impedances already on 100 MVA base. Power balance must hold such that total generation equals total load plus total losses. The lowest-voltage bus in the solved case is bus 14.
